script:
trace=wp.zeros((1,2,r.old.WIDTH),dtype=r.D)
t=trace.numpy();t[0,:,0]=1;trace.assign(t)
ncon=wp.array(np.array([3],np.int32));world=wp.array(np.array([0,1,0],np.int32))
overflow=wp.zeros(2,dtype=int);com=wp.array(np.array([[[1,2,3]],[[4,5,6]]],np.float32),dtype=wp.vec3)
meta=wp.zeros((1,2,6),dtype=r.D)
wp.launch(r.contact_counts,2,[0,ncon,world,3,overflow,0,com,trace,meta])
np.testing.assert_array_equal(meta.numpy()[0],[[3,2,0,1,2,3],[3,1,0,4,5,6]])
wp.launch(r.contact_counts,2,[0,ncon,world,2,overflow,0,com,trace,meta])
assert np.array_equal(meta.numpy()[0,:,2],[-1,-1])
overflow.assign(np.array([1,2],np.int32));wp.launch(r.contact_counts,2,[0,ncon,world,3,overflow,0,com,trace,meta])
np.testing.assert_array_equal(meta.numpy()[0,:,2],[1,2])
meta.zero_();t[0,1,0]=0;trace.assign(t)
wp.launch(r.contact_counts,2,[0,ncon,world,3,overflow,0,com,trace,meta])
assert not meta.numpy()[0,1].any()
